user.title: HouseFly
user.description:
Watching is free and safe; touching is neither, so they are separate questions. Turn on whole-house watching and it smells everything read-only, which is what makes "something unusual" worth anything — a novelty detector fed six sensors can only notice six kinds of strange. What it may touch stays a short, explicit list, and actuation is off until you turn it on.

You can add more than one. Give each a name and, if you want them on shifts, shift their days apart — a fly is crepuscular, so one six hours out is awake while the others sleep (six, not twelve — twelve maps morning onto evening and changes almost nothing), and a sleeping fly cannot touch anything.
